headline: Deploy role has unrestricted permissions across all AWS services and resources

findings.evidence_ref: iam.tf lines 55-67: policy grants Action='*' and Resource='*', allowing the CodeBuild role to perform any action on any AWS resource
findings.explanation: The deploy role can assume full administrative privileges over the entire AWS account. This violates the principle of least privilege and creates a significant security risk. Any compromise of the CodeBuild process becomes account-wide compromise. Even as a temporary measure, wildcard policies should not be merged to production infrastructure.

findings.evidence_ref: plan.txt shows 'aws_db_instance.main will be updated in-place' with only '(30 unchanged attributes hidden)' and no visible changes shown
findings.explanation: The plan shows the database will be updated but provides no details about what changed. This is suspicious—either there's a hidden attribute change or drift in the state that isn't being displayed clearly. Before merging, verify what database configuration is actually changing.
